messages:
elaine: Opening a small docs PR to modernize the Hello Starter quickstart. Main goals: switch examples to REDWOOD_API_KEY env var, add a devcontainer snippet for VS Code Codespaces, and replace the legacy `docker run` step with `docker compose` local-compose. PR: #4399. Looking for one reviewer.
jorge: Sounds good. Can you paste the new minimal snippets here so I can sanity-check the code blocks?
tia: Also drop a one-line migration note: 'If you previously used SESSION_TOKEN, set REDWOOD_API_KEY=...; see migration guide.' Keep it non-alarming.
elaine: Snippets pasted below (kept tiny):
```bash
# .env
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_XXXX
```
```js
// index.js (node)
const Redwood = require('redwood');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-mini', input: 'Hi!' });
console.log(res.text);
```
jorge: Nit: recommend `redwood-mini` in examples (cheap + fast). Also add a local run line: `docker compose up --build hello-starter` so folks get a predictable command.
tia: Add devcontainer note: in devcontainer.json include "runArgs": ["-e", "REDWOOD_API_KEY=${localEnv:REDWOOD_API_KEY}"] and call out secret storage for prod. Also add link to enterprise auth for Private/KMS users.
elaine: Added both. CI bot: lint OK, linkcheck fixed one broken anchor, preview up at https://deploy-preview-4399--docs.redwood.ai
cia-bot: Smoke test queued after merge.
jorge: I left two tiny copy edits. LGTM otherwise. Approving now.
tia: Approved. Merge when green and run staging smoke test.
elainE: Merged! I'll follow up with a micro-e2e that runs the quickstart in CI and a migration blurb in the migration guide. Thanks all.
